title: Love Actually
events_chronological: At an airport arrivals gate, strangers meet the people they love, and a voice observes that love is actually all around.
The newly elected Prime Minister, David, meets Natalie, who works in the household at Downing Street.
The ageing rocker Billy Mack records a Christmas version of an old hit and tells every interviewer that it is rubbish.
Juliet marries Peter, and Peter's best friend Mark films the whole wedding.
Daniel buries his wife and cannot get his stepson Sam to speak to him.
Jamie finds his girlfriend in bed with his brother and goes to France to write alone.
Harry, who runs a design agency, finds his new secretary Mia paying him a great deal of attention.
Karen, Harry's wife, runs a household around her daughter's part in a school nativity play.
Sarah, who works for Harry, has loved a colleague called Karl for years and is interrupted every time by telephone calls from her ill brother.
Sam tells Daniel he is in love with a girl at school called Joanna, and Daniel is relieved that it is only that.
Jamie and his Portuguese housekeeper Aurelia fall in love without a word of language in common.
Mark shows Juliet the wedding footage, which turns out to be entirely of her, and later stands at her door with a stack of cue cards.
The visiting United States President makes a pass at Natalie, and David denounces him at the press conference.
Harry buys Mia a necklace, and Karen finds it, assumes it is hers, and is given a compact disc instead.
Sarah and Karl go home together, and she leaves the bed to answer her brother's call.
Billy Mack's record reaches number one and he spends Christmas Eve with his manager Joe rather than at a party.
Jamie flies to Portugal and proposes to Aurelia in front of her entire street, David finds Natalie backstage at the nativity play, and Daniel takes Sam through airport security to catch Joanna.
Five weeks later everybody arrives at the same airport, and the film closes on the same gate it opened on.
syuzhet_notes: Nine loosely linked stories run at the same time through the weeks before Christmas, cut between constantly and joined only by a handful of shared characters. The film never goes back in time.
fabula_notes: The five weeks are continuous and captioned by a countdown. Strands that are simultaneous can be ranked either way.
